Respected Sir,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to respectfully request your approval for a late registration for the upcoming academic year at Symbiosis Institute of Technology (SIT). Due to an unforeseen medical emergency in my family, I am unable to attend the registration process on the scheduled date.

My grandfather has been suddenly hospitalized, and as a result, I must remain with my family to manage the situation. This circumstance prevents me from being present on the original registration date.

I fully understand the importance of adhering to deadlines and assure you that I am committed to my academic journey at SIT. I would be sincerely grateful if you could kindly allow me to complete the registration process on January 12th, 2024.

Thank you for your understanding and consideration of my request. I look forward to your positive response.

Yours faithfully,
